Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the interest. Would love to get a 30–45min demo scheduled this week. To avoid any DST confusion, I listed the same three options with explicit timezone labels so we can pick one that works for your team. Please reply with the preferred slot and I’ll send a calendar invite with the timezone set to CET (or UTC) per your preference.

Option A (preferred):
- Thu Mar 19, 2026 — 09:00 CET / 08:00 GMT+0 / 00:00 PT / 03:00 ET
Option B:
- Thu Mar 19, 2026 — 14:00 CET / 13:00 GMT+0 / 05:00 PT / 08:00 ET
Option C (late day for EU):
- Fri Mar 20, 2026 — 16:00 CET / 15:00 GMT+0 / 07:00 PT / 10:00 ET

Quick note on DST: the US moved to DST on Mar 8, 2026 (PT/ET are currently DST). Europe will move to CEST on Mar 29, 2026. Because of that, CET (Europe) is currently one hour behind ET in absolute offset for these dates — that’s why I included explicit labels. If you prefer a UTC invite to avoid ambiguity, I can send that instead.

Also attaching a short agenda and I’ll include an .ics when we lock a slot.

Thanks —
